## Top Reasons for User Unhappiness

**1. Playback stops unexpectedly** — 2,743 mentions, 99.5% negative.
- "the song stop after playing and also after a song completed it stops" [#rv_-1029322525425522179]
- "Frequently force close and current play button is missing" [#rv_-1051710898914992069]

**2. App crashes and playback pauses** — 2,274 mentions, 99.2% negative.
- "it randomly pauses whatever you're listening to every few minutes. It's almost unusable" [#rv_-4590269424303302968]
- "The app seems to randomly pause my music lately" despite troubleshooting [#rv_-449593098617826570]

**3. Offline playback failures** — 1,143 mentions, 98.3% negative, +32.2% recent growth.
- "my liked downloaded songs take forever to load while offline" [#rv_-4478620269037857079]
- "it wont allow me to play my downloaded playlist while offline" [#rv_-4495855585418452781]

**4. Premium required for full playback** — 1,155 mentions, 96.9% negative.
- "we have to get premium for almost EVERYTHING" [#rv_-4748039116532990364]
- "Can't even find music you are paying to listen to" [#rv_-4558459259307250353]

**5. Premium payment & access issues** — 980 mentions, 97.3% negative, highest urgency (0.536).
- "pop-up prompt that my payment failed... will not allow me to pay" [#rv_-4792514023413032031]
- "I have a free account but I just got charged $9.99" [#rv_-500124091293636314]

**Notable spikes:** Critical alerts for unexpected log-outs and login failures (2022-03-08), plus repeated crash spikes in April–May 2022.
